note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; decision identifiers are invented placeholders, not citations. No preset states which reading is better or what a decision holds.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Same card, same unfolding to paragraph 3; A's lens reads the summary, B's lens reads the passage of the decision text.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the summary points to paragraph 2, so in both scenes the text opens only one panel and B's lens stops higher on the first panel; different decision, texts and researcher.
